findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product and results passes to the client immediately upon creation or performance, without being conditioned on receiving full payment first.
findings.suggested_change: All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials shall remain your property until you have received full payment of all compensation due under this Agreement, at which time ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the paperwork. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose one small adjustment before signing. - In the relevant clause, ownership of the work product currently passes immediately upon creation rather than being conditioned on receiving full payment first. I suggest modifying this to ensure payment precedes the transfer of rights, with the following wording: All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials shall remain your property until you have received full payment of all compensation due under this Agreement, at which time ownership shall transfer to the Client. Thank you, and I look forward to moving ahead.
